name: Ricardo Bernal
bio:
Ricardo’s passion for motorsport was ignited during his childhood in Buenos Aires, attending local Turismo Carretera races with his grandfather. Witnessing the raw emotion and fierce competition sparked a lifelong dream of contributing to the sport. After earning a degree in Journalism and Communications, he honed his skills at a small sports agency, managing media relations for local athletes.

He joined FVee Brasil three years ago, drawn by the team's underdog spirit and commitment to developing young talent. Ricardo approaches PR with a strategic, data-driven mindset, always seeking innovative ways to engage fans and build positive media coverage. He believes in authentic storytelling and fostering genuine relationships with journalists and influencers. His ability to connect with diverse audiences and craft compelling narratives sets him apart in the competitive world of motorsport PR.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight wave
physical.description: Ricardo is of medium height with a lean build.

quirks: Always carries a worn copy of a book on motorsport marketing strategies.
Insists on having a mate (tea) during every press conference.
Has a habit of sketching out marketing campaigns on napkins during meetings.
